datasets.name: Global Very-High-Resolution Landslide Mapping (GVLM) dataset
datasets.verbatim: Zhang, Yu, et al. (2023) created the global very-high-resolution landslide mapping (GVLM) landslide change detection dataset, covering 17 countries and regions across six continents to augment landslide datasets.

datasets.name: Wenchuan earthquake landslide dataset
datasets.verbatim: Additionally, datasets of two earthquake-triggered landslide events of Nepal and Wenchuan, collected from Google Earth, are constructed to evaluate the practical transferability of our proposed model.

datasets.name: Landslide4Scene dataset
datasets.verbatim: Additionally, Ghorbanzadeh, Xu, Ghamisi, et al. (2022) developed the Landslide4Scene dataset (https://zenodo.org/records/10463239), which includes landslide images from four distinct regions.

methods.name: Multi-Scale Difference Enhancement Network (MSDENet)
methods.summary: MSDENet is an end-to-end Siamese network architecture for landslide extraction from dual-temporal images. It features a Difference Guided Attention Module (DGAM) for focusing on landslide-specific changes, a Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Module (MSFFM) for boundary delineation, and a Multi-Scale Sensory Module (MSSM) for multi-scale feature integration and generalization.
methods.source: Bo Yu, Meijiang Zhu, Fang Chen, Ning Wang, Huichen Zhao & Lei Wang
methods.verbatim: To address these challenges, we introduce the Multi-Scale Difference Enhancement Network (MSDENet), a framework for landslide extraction through time-based change detection.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are mentioned but not linked, and the custom code for the MSDENet method is not provided or linked.
